title: CISA: Medusa ransomware hit over 500 critical infrastructure orgs
summary: The FBI said Tuesday that the Medusa ransomware gang has breached more than 500 critical infrastructure organizations in the United States since June 2021. [...]

title: Ransom Busters Claims It Hacked Ransomware Servers, Asks Victims for Up to $60,000
summary:
A ransomware affiliate calling itself Ransom Busters has been spotted proactively sending emails to victim organizations and claims to delete stolen data from ransomware groups' servers in exchange for a fee ranging from $20,000 to $60,000.

"In these messages, the third-party offers to help the victim recover from ransomware attack. This immediately stands out as anomalous," GuidePoint Research

title: 'Ransom Busters': Ransomware Actor Poses as Incident-Recovery Service
summary: A ransomware affiliate appears to be sidling up to victims with offers of aid, masking its true intention of diverting ransom payments.
